description:
PushNow brings the important results of your scripts, AI agents and automated workflows to a focused inbox on iPhone. Check a completed build, read a generated report or save an event for later without keeping a terminal open.

AN INBOX FOR YOUR AUTOMATIONS
Connect a sender through the documented API or command-line tools. Review incoming items in one place, open their details and organize your attention with notification priorities. Your sender decides what to send; PushNow provides the receiving experience.

NOTIFY NOW, SCHEDULE, OR SAVE
Send an immediate notification when a result needs attention, schedule a reminder for a later time, or save an item to the inbox without requesting a push. A saved message and a scheduled reminder have different purposes, so you can keep useful information without making every event an interruption.

MORE CONTEXT IN EACH MESSAGE
Supported encrypted messages can include Markdown, images, files and links. Open a report to read its formatted content and inspect supported attachments on your device. Your automation must provide the content; PushNow does not independently monitor your servers or run your agents.

AUTHORIZE YOUR OWN SENDERS
Sign in with your verified email account. Use the device and sender controls to authorize compatible integrations, manage sending keys and inspect delivery logs. Additional devices use a trusted-device approval flow to access encrypted account history.

ENCRYPTED CONTENT
Compatible v2 senders encrypt message content and attachments before upload. The app decrypts supported content locally. Account information and the routing metadata required to operate the service remain available to the service; encryption does not mean that all metadata is hidden.

START WITH FREE, UPGRADE WHEN NEEDED
Free includes up to 50 notification items per day. Optional Plus and Pro monthly subscriptions provide 500 daily items and no daily item-count limit respectively. Pro remains subject to service and abuse-prevention limits. The membership screen shows your local App Store price before purchase and includes Restore Purchases. Features require an account and internet access.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE
Choose light or dark appearance and use the app in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish or German. Start with the setup and troubleshooting guides on our website.

Push notification delivery depends on Apple Push Notification service, network connectivity, device state, notification permissions and Focus settings. PushNow is not an emergency-alert service. Discovery channel preferences currently save locally pending activation; automated third-party channel delivery is not included.
